meta.title: PartiDesign: what happens when you ask for a design
meta.subtitle: 400 flow steps, then one decode, then a ranking pass

transitions.label: same denoiser
transitions.note: all 400 steps share one set of weights; nothing is re-trained per request

cards.title: What the user supplies, and what it constrains
items: A context molecule - protein, nucleic acid or small molecule - plus optional receptor hotspots that focus generation on one interaction site

Fixed identities hold residues needed for recognition or chemistry; backbone, full-residue and partial-atom motifs hold selected structure; contigs join the retained segments through newly designed regions
Coarse guidance sets the whole design's class (the alpha class needs at least 40% alpha and at most 10% beta), while fine conditions label individual tokens and their pairwise relationships
Explicit topology constraints specify nonstandard bonds by atom endpoints, which is how cyclic peptides and antibody designs are requested

cards.title: What the 400 steps actually move
items: Two things at once: the token centers, which are where each residue or ligand atom sits, and the eight-dimensional latents, which hold identity and local geometry. Neither waits for the other
Self-conditioning feeds the previous step's clean prediction back in, so each step refines an estimate rather than starting fresh

The frozen autoencoder's decoder then turns the generated latents into polymer coordinates and identities across 91 atom slots, and a separate three-layer message-passing decoder turns ligand tokens into a chemical graph with bond orders and formal charges

cards.title: What the reported latency does and does not include
items: Timed: context VAE encoding, the solver, and decoding - measured at batch 16 on one RTX 4090-48G with Inductor compilation, and divided by 16 for a per-candidate cost

Not timed: CPU proposal construction, molecular assembly, output writing, chemical reconstruction, relaxation and optional PartiScore scoring. Model loading, compilation and warmup are also outside the interval

Comparisons run each method at its own native recipe, so the step counts differ: PartiDesign at 400 flow steps, RFdiffusion3 at 200 sampler steps, BoltzGen at 500 steps with three recycles and 16 diffusion samples
